newsitem.title: ITALY: Parmalat sees 97 turnover at 7.2 trln lire.
newsitem.headline: Parmalat sees 97 turnover at 7.2 trln lire.

text.p: Italian food group Parmalat Finanziaria said in a statement it expected group turnover to be more than 7.2 trillion lire in 1997, including Beatrice Foods Inc in which it announced earlier it was buying a 75 percent stake.

Parmalat said: "For 1997 the Parmalat group sees a turnover of 6.1 trillion lire, with internal growth of 12 percent, which with the acquisition of Beatrice Foods will bring it to beyond 7.2 trillion, with net operating income of more than 8.0 percent."
Earlier Parmalat said it was buying a 75.1 percent stake in Canadian food group Beatrice Foods Inc with Citicorp buying 24.9 percent, in a deal worth a total C$290 million dollars.
